The Banilla Co Clean It Zero Green Peel Toner pad is the best toner pad I've used. I have very oily skin so toning is a necessity for me. I usually get the toner & add it to a cotton pad, but this product simplifies that process. They are presoaked & I love that it includes tweezers to help remove the pads. The actual texture is what really won me over. Most toning pads are too rough & harsh, in my opinion. These are rough enough to slightly exfoliate, but not feel scratchy. The actual formula on the pads effectively clarifies & balanced my skin. I'm having no oily issues on the days I use this product. I'm so happy I've discovered this brand. I see why the K-Beauty craze is alive & well. I'd highly recommend for oily, unbalanced skin.

The zero green peel toner is just great. My face feels fresh and clean after using it. They are oversized pads (in a rather oversized jar!) which makes them much easier to use that the standard pad size. These pads are good as touch ups between face washes, esp if you have oil skin like me. It takes some of the oil off and leaves your face feeling refreshed and cleaner.
I absolutely love this product so much! I highly recommend this.

I use makeup cloths to remove the makeup from my face after cleansing. But, I always feel like I need to use a exfoliant or toner afterwards. I tried the Clean it Zero green peel toner pads and I love how it removed my waterproof eye make-up and left my skin feeling much brighter and smooth. I have combination skin, but I tend to be more oily, especially at the end of the day. The toner pad removed my excess oil and didn't dry out my skin. The packaging is really well designed and includes little tongs to pick up only one toner pad at a time. Other toner pads that I've tried in the past are hard to pick up and you end up picking up a few and putting the extras back in. Which then causes them to dry out. Not a problem with these toner pads. They never dried out! Also, after cleaning my face, I used the pads on my elbows. I don't have really rough elbows, but what does it hurt?! Clean ingredients and clean skin. Best clean product I've used in awhile! Gifted by Banila Co.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again ❤️
avis.texte: As someone who struggles with oily, congested skin, finding the right skincare products can often feel like an endless battle. However, my quest for clearer, balanced skin led me to Banila Co's Clean it Zero Green Peel Toner Pads, and I'm thrilled to say that they've become a game-changer in my routine. From the moment I opened the jar, I was impressed by the promise of highly concentrated, vegan dual-sided toner pads packed with skin-clearing ingredients and exfoliants. The convenience of having a powerful treatment in a pre-soaked pad format appealed to my busy lifestyle, and I was eager to put them to the test. Using the toner pads just three times a week, as recommended, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and clarity. The dual-sided design allowed me to gently exfoliate and remove dead skin cells with one side, while the other side balanced oil production and strengthened my skin's natural barrier. What truly sets these toner pads apart is their clinically proven formula. Dermatologist tested and vegan-friendly, they effectively target excess oil, buildup, dead skin cells, and breakouts without causing any irritation or dryness. Instead, my skin felt refreshed, soothed, and noticeably clearer after each use. I appreciated the versatility of these pads—they can be used anytime, anywhere, making them a convenient solution for on-the-go skincare. Whether I'm at home or traveling, I can rely on these pads to keep my skin feeling balanced and refreshed th
